timebase: Every timecode is a FINAL-spine second (ALL.e.enhanced.mp4), before the card pauses and before the CH1 montage. The mixer routes them through sh(). File times are the decoded timeline the mixer trims on (checked: plain decode = PTS for all five files).
ruling: Mike, PROJECT-LOG 2026-11-22: the intro (CH1) may carry the energetic bed of the video; every chapter after it gets SUBTLE music only (the subtle sections of a chill track, or a drone), no aggressive or epic section after CH1. So: Bed A = focuser, carved, CH1 only. Bed B = what-we-must, one drumless pass. Bed C = the two calm cuts of oh-mega, carved on its 2-bar figure, never its chorus. Bed D = the sacral drone, right-aligned, resolving on the last word with no epic hit. Four beds, three cards (CH2, CH3, CH5); CH4 continues Bed C as a carve.

levels.seat_rule: gain = (VO -20.1) - target - region LUFS.
